assyria: the Middle Assyrian Empire page keeps 'the line of vassal rulers of Hanigalbat' (Ili-ipadda, 'grand vizier and vassal king of Hanigalbat') under Enlil-kudurri-usur (king list c. 1196-1192), so Hanigalbat may have stayed under Assyria as a vassal into the 1190s; the patch draws it nobody's from -1200 on the page's 'restricted mostly to just the Assyrian heartland'.
